color_digest_algorithm_unknown.description: A color digest declaration names an algorithm other than color_digest.v1.

color_digest_grid_invalid.description: A color digest grid is refused: an axis lies outside 1..=32 cells, or the grid has more cells than the region has pixels on an axis.

color_digest_region_invalid.description: A color digest region is refused: it does not lie inside the frame or its bounds overflow.

color_digest_cells_invalid.description: A color digest's cells are refused: the hex encoding has the wrong length, is not lowercase hex, or holds a channel above the quantized maximum.

color_digest_exclude_cells_invalid.description: A color digest's exclude_cells list is refused: an index lies outside the grid, the list is not strictly ascending, or it leaves no active cell.

color_digest_grid_mismatch.description: Two color digests cannot be compared because their grids differ.
